summary: Phase-3 full regression: 45 pytest cases (test_phase3.py new + test_auth_security.py new + existing test_phase2.py) and 5 Playwright UI journeys against the public preview URL. Backend 43/45 passing. All Phase-3 features verified end-to-end: DB-backed coupons with expiry/min-order, similar + frequently-bought-together, Razorpay DEMO payment flow (create -> verify -> order.status=confirmed/payment_status=paid), buyer cancel, seller bulk CSV upload (download sample -> preview -> confirm import), seller orders queue with status advance, seller verified/pending badges, lazy-load image skeletons. Two real defects found (expired coupon leaking into GET /api/coupons; no brute-force login lockout) plus several minor copy/UX issues.

minor.issue: Returns 4 coupons incl. EXPIRED10 because the query only filters is_active and ignores expires_at. Spec expects 3 active coupons; this also regresses tests/test_phase2.py::TestCoupons::test_list_coupons. Fix: add {"expires_at": {"$gt": now_iso}} to the find filter (or set EXPIRED10 is_active=false and keep the apply-time expiry check).
No brute-force protection: 6 consecutive wrong passwords all return 401 with no lockout/429/423 and no failed-attempt counter. Playbook requires lockout after 5 failures.

Inserted products omit the denormalised `seller_verified` flag (verified via API: value is null for bulk products). ProductCard renders the pending note only when seller_verified === false, so bulk products of an unverified seller (seller3) will never show 'Pending verification' until the app restarts and re-denormalises. Set seller_verified from the seller doc at insert time.
Admin is only inserted when missing; if ADMIN_PASSWORD changes in .env the existing admin hash is never updated (playbook expects idempotent seed that updates the password).

Invalid/expired coupon at order time is silently swallowed (discount=0) - order total may differ from the total the buyer saw. Consider returning 400 or an explicit coupon_rejected flag so the UI can inform the user.

ui_bugs.issue: Success toast reads 'Marked Mark Shipped' (duplicated verb) because it interpolates the button label: toast.success(`Marked ${meta.label}`).
Payment summary always says 'Paid via COD' for unpaid Cash-on-Delivery orders; should read 'Cash on Delivery (pay on delivery)'. Success page also shows 'Total paid' for COD.
Stale 'PHASE 2 - Product management coming soon / Order queue, shipping labels' placeholder cards remain even though Orders queue and Bulk upload now exist.

issues: Seller filter lists raw truncated IDs ('Seller 1ec6a2', 'Seller e94122') instead of business names - unusable filter labels
Sort control is a native browser <select> instead of the shadcn Select component
All products in a category share the same 3-4 seeded Unsplash images, so Similar Products / grid rows look like duplicates of one image
Bundle/similar thumbnails are identical images for same-category items (seed data reuses one image list per category)

action_items: Filter expired coupons out of GET /api/coupons (expires_at > now) so it returns the 3 truly-active coupons and test_phase2 passes again.
Add failed-login attempt tracking + lockout (5 attempts) on POST /api/auth/login.
Set seller_verified on products created by POST /api/seller/products/bulk.
Make admin seeding idempotent - update password_hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD differs.
Fix 'Marked Mark Shipped' toast copy in SellerOrdersPage.
Change 'Paid via COD' wording for unpaid COD orders.
Use seller business_name (not raw id) in CategoryPage seller filter; replace native sort <select> with shadcn Select.
Optional: surface coupon rejection at order creation instead of silently zeroing the discount.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 962 lines and mixes auth, catalog, orders, payments, seller tools and seeding - split into routers (auth/catalog/orders/payments/seller) + seed module.
list_coupons() must apply the same validity rules used by _compute_discount(); duplicating validity logic in two places already caused the EXPIRED10 leak.

bulk_upload_products() inserts documents one-by-one in a loop; use insert_many for the valid batch, and reuse the same product-doc builder as the seed helper to avoid drift (missing seller_verified is exactly this drift).
PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status allows ANY seller/admin to move ANY order (no seller_ids ownership check) unlike /api/seller/orders/{id}/status - tighten or remove the legacy endpoint.
verify_payment stores razorpay_signature verbatim; fine for demo but avoid persisting signatures once real keys are live.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of Phase-3 flows functional (minor copy/design issues only)

rca_of_the_issue: EXPIRED10 leak: DEFAULT_COUPONS seeds EXPIRED10 with is_active=True (so the negative apply test works), but GET /api/coupons filters only on is_active and never compares expires_at, while _compute_discount() does the expiry check. Result: an expired coupon is advertised publicly and the phase-2 count assertion breaks. Brute-force gap: login() has no attempt counter/lockout store, so unlimited credential guessing is possible.
